Home › Volunteer vacancies

We're recruiting

Join our team

Behind every great Scout Group is a team of volunteers who keep it running well and lead the way. We have a few important roles open right now, from section leadership to our trustees, and we would love to hear from you, whatever your background. You do not need any Scouting experience.

Group Lead Volunteer

Our most senior volunteer role: set the direction for the Group and empower volunteers to deliver great Scouting, working with our trustees and the District to help the Group thrive.

  • Build a team and share responsibility
  • Support three Section Support Leads
  • Champion safe, inclusive Scouting

Section Support Lead

Join our Group Leadership Team and work with the Group Lead Volunteer to support a Beavers, Cubs or Scouts team, helping their volunteers succeed. Three roles are open, one per section.

  • Build a stronger volunteer team
  • Support recruitment and development
  • Help resolve issues and share ideas

Treasurer

Look after the Group's finances: budgets, accounts, subscriptions and Gift Aid. Ideal if you enjoy keeping things organised, with a full handover and support provided.

  • Look after budgets and accounts
  • Manage subscriptions and Gift Aid
  • Bring your organisation and a head for numbers

Trustee, fundraising and bids

Help secure the funding that makes adventures possible, through fundraising and writing grant applications and bids. Experience with funding applications is a real bonus.

  • Write bids and grant applications
  • Support local and district events
  • Bring fresh fundraising ideas

What is involved

Our leadership team and trustees look after the running of the Group: our people, our finances, our safety and our longer term plans, so our section volunteers can focus on giving young people brilliant adventures. Most roles ask for only a few meetings or sessions a month, and we will always talk everything through with you first, with no pressure.

Interested? Let us know

Send us a message and choose Governance as your reason, and we will be in touch for a friendly, no-pressure chat.

Register your interest → Or email trustees@7thswindon.org.uk

7th Swindon Scout Group

Part of Swindon North Scout District, we're one of the largest Scout Groups in North Swindon, helping over 300 young people develop skills for life every week.
